data.name: Uday
data.gender_notes: Uday is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit ud, 'up', + i, 'to go' — 'rise, sunrise'. Its root is Sanskrit ud + i. A classical Sanskrit term for sunrise. Uday is a Sanskrit name meaning “Rise; ascent; sunrise”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Uday expresses “Rise; ascent; sunrise”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit ud, 'up', + i, 'to go' — 'rise, sunrise'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Uday total 15, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

data.cultural_impact: Uday is used in Sanskrit naming tradition with the meaning “Rise; ascent; sunrise”.

vedic_reference.note: Refers to the Sun God and the act of rising or being born.
